Enter just the server root (e.g. https://dav.jianguoyun.com/dav/); Rift creates a Rift folder under it automatically and stores one fixed file, rift_backup.json, overwriting the previous copy. Off by default. Tested: leaving it off keeps connections alive after sleep.
Detect traffic protocols/domains for more accurate routing.
Domains resolve to fake IPs inside the VPN

When on, domains resolve to 198.18.x.x fake addresses inside the VPN and the node fetches the real address. This prevents DNS leaks and improves routing accuracy. Note: some apps may need a restart to reconnect after the proxy stops. Recommended: keep on.
If the network is unstable or streams drop often, try a smaller value (e.g. 1400); it takes effect after reconnecting. Leave it alone otherwise.
Detect traffic protocol and domain for accurate routing
When on, the core inspects each flow\'s protocol and domain for more accurate routing. Turning it off may make routing less accurate. Recommended: keep on.
Drop old connections and reconnect on network change
After switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data, old connections may hang; when on, they are dropped and reconnected automatically. Recommended: keep on.
Reset connections after waking from sleep
Off by default. Tested more stable when off: no stream drops after waking. Turning it on may cause an extra reconnect on wake.
Uploads only after a config change; failures stay silent and are only noted in the status line below. Recommended: keep on.
